g.text: Seven forecasting architectures | 18,839 aligned synthetic validation windows | Exact saved PR curves

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4f5d70

g.text: Figure 2. Precision–recall curves for 5-, 10-, and 15-minute future-attack prediction. Stacked LSTM, CR-LSTM and GCN-LSTM are emphasized; other evaluated architectures remain visible.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4f5d70

g.text: Average precision is computed from the exact saved curves and differs from overall classification accuracy. Positive prevalence increases with forecast horizon.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f6e80

g.text: Synthetic NAF v2 development validation. The other Graph LSTM variants are compared in Table 1 but have no curves in the F09 archive. No independent-window confidence intervals are implied.
